subject: PO acknowledgement cadence, invoice cutoff and early-pay pathway
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: contracts@wavefront-analytics.com
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: PO acknowledgement cadence, invoice cutoff & early-pay option

Hi Sonia —

Good to meet you yesterday on the call. As we move Wavefront through Redwood's vendor activation, a couple quick items to align on so AP can process POs and invoices without delays: 

- PO acknowledgement: we require a signed PO acknowledgement within 48 hours of PO issue to avoid hold flags. I attached our short "PO_Acknowledgement_Template.docx" for ease.
- Invoice cutoff: for consistent remittance we close the invoice window on the 5th of each month for charges posted prior month. Invoices submitted after the 5th will move to the next payment cycle.
- Default payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 45. We can consider an early-pay program to accelerate cash to vendors — typically we pilot for the first 90 days. Cost of early pay is a small percentage of invoice value.

Can you confirm Wavefront's PO format (numbering, mandatory fields) and whether your AP can accept PDF invoices that reference our PO number? Also, do you have a preferred early-pay structure (e.g., 1% within 15 days)? Diego will own the onboarding checklist and technical setup.

I attached the vendor onboarding form (PDF) and a simple NetTerms matrix for reference.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, NetTermsMatrix.xlsx

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@wavefront-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:28:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO acknowledgement cadence, invoice cutoff & early-pay option

Marissa/Diego —

Thanks for the summary. Quick answers from Wavefront Procurement: 

- PO format: We use WF-##### (e.g., WF-10234). Mandatory fields: PO number, ship-to (if applicable), line item descriptions, unit price, and vendor remit name + address. We can include Redwood's PO number on the invoice PDF.
- Invoice submission: PDF upload to our supplier portal is preferred; we can accept emailed invoices for initial onboarding but will require portal enrollment within 30 days.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net 60. However, we are open to an early-pay discount. A 1% discount for payment within 15 days is common for vendors who can accommodate accelerated remits.

Operational asks from our side: please provide W-9 (or equivalent), bank remittance form, and a sample invoice referencing a PO. Can you also confirm whether Redwood requires a separate PO acknowledgement doc or whether an emailed "Accepted" with a signature line is sufficient?

I'll loop in our AP lead if we get to an agreed terms sheet.

Best,
Sonia Patel
Procurement Manager, Wavefront Analytics

(Attachment: WF_PO_Rules.pdf)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@wavefront-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO acknowledgement cadence, invoice cutoff & early-pay option

Sonia —

Appreciate the quick reply and clarity on Wavefront's side. To make onboarding smooth, here is a condensed operational plan we propose: 

1) Paperwork & portal: Marissa will send the vendor package. Please complete the Vendor Onboarding Form (attached), and we will send a DocuSign for the W-9 + bank remittance. Once we have that, we can create the Redwood vendor record so future PO numbers include the vendor remit details.

2) PO acknowledgement: we can accept a signed copy of your PO (PDF) or a one-line emailed acknowledgement that includes PO number, accepted line items, and an authorized name. For automation, signed PDF is preferred — acknowledgement should come within 48 hours of PO issue to avoid the invoice hold that delays payment.

3) Invoice cutoff & timing: to align with Wavefront's portal cadence and Redwood's monthly close, let's use the following compromise: invoices dated on or before the 5th of the month will be considered for the same-month batch; invoices after the 5th roll to the next cycle. If Wavefront requires different cutoff windows for specific cost centers, please flag them and we'll create routing rules.

4) Payment terms & early-pay pilot: Redwood standard is Net 45. Given Wavefront's Net 60 preference, we propose a 90-day pilot: Net 45 as the base, with a 1.5% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 15 days. After the pilot, we'll re-evaluate with both AP teams. That gives Wavefront better cash preservation while providing a modest yield boost to vendors.

5) PO numbering & sample invoice: please send a sample invoice (PDF) referencing a Wavefront PO so our billing team can validate mapping.

I've attached three documents: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable), NetTermsMatrix.xlsx (shows the proposed discount tiers), and PO_Acknowledgement_Template.docx. 

Next steps: Sonia, if that plan is acceptable, can you confirm and I will trigger the DocuSign package this afternoon? Marissa will follow with the onboarding ticket and expected timeline for vendor record creation.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Sr. Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, NetTermsMatrix.xlsx, PO_Acknowledgement_Template.docx

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@wavefront-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO acknowledgement cadence, invoice cutoff & early-pay option

Diego/Marissa —

That all sounds workable. We accept the 48-hour PO acknowledgement requirement and will pilot the Net 45 + 1.5% early-pay (15-day) for 90 days. I'll: 

- Complete the Vendor_Onboarding_Form by EOD Monday and sign the DocuSign for W-9/bank details.
- Upload a sample invoice to our portal and confirm the PO mapping.
- Share the AP lead's info so you can coordinate payment exceptions if anything comes up during the pilot.

Please send the DocuSign link and onboarding ticket. Looking forward to a smooth activation.

Best regards,
Sonia
Procurement Manager
Wavefront Analytics
